title: Pollen balances now separate tier grants from packs
summary:
Two fixes closed the year: Pollen balances now distinguish tier grants from packs, and Gemini 3 Flash fast mode uses a zero-token thinking budget.

Balance tracking now keeps tier grants and purchased packs separate, so daily tier resets do not throw off the total. Billable requests draw from the tier balance before the pack balance.

An authenticated balance endpoint returns both balances, their total, and the last tier-grant time. Enter’s dashboard now uses it for the balance display.

Requests to disable thinking now send a zero-token thinking budget instead of a setting that only selected minimal thinking. Gemini 2.5 and 3 Pro keep their existing model-specific behavior.
